'''March 2001 Phoenix tournament (23 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ on 23 March 2001. [[Michael Girard]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1940">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-viper-is-almost-cool-phoenix-3-23-01d1940/ viper-is-almost-cool-phoenix-3-23-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-viper-is-almost-cool-phoenix-3-23-01d1940/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 March 2001
* '''Site:''' The Outer Rim, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Girard]]
